Four things it does well

Each one measured on teams of five to fifty people, over one quarter.

Triage

New issues land in one queue with an owner by default.

Cycles

Two weeks, a scope, and a single place to see it slip.

Reviews

Every change links back to the issue that asked for it.

Reports

Numbers the team trusts because they come from its own work.

One command to start

Install the client, then run relay init --team core in any repository.

Everything else is configured from the issues themselves.
